desc:
Welcome to Pineville! The ultimate place to explore, make friends, and live your own story. Dive into an open world where every corner has something to discover — from schools and hospitals to hidden hangout spots. Whether you're a new student in the Pineville Highschool, roleplaying a new life, or just cruising around town, there's always something fun to do. Build your dream house, start a family, or take on a new job — how you live is completely up to you.

👮 Be a Police Officer – Keep the streets safe.
🧑‍⚕️ Be a Doctor – Help those in need.
🎓 Go to School – Learn, roleplay, and have fun!
🏠 Build a Life – Own a house and start a family!
🎉 Make Friends – Explore the town and meet new people.

Your life, your way — only in Pineville.
